item.text:
**Overall:** mostly yes. The 2024 record contains repeated evidence of policies aimed at broader, longer-run prosperity: poverty reduction, regional balancing, land regularization, deforestation cuts, and some fiscal restraint. The clearest caveat is that Lula also used politically popular rhetoric against the central bank while markets worried about fiscal credibility.

- [Governo Federal promulga decreto para fortalecer desenvolvimento regional e reduzir desigualdades no país](https://www.gov.br/mdr/pt-br/noticias/governo-federal-promulga-decreto-para-fortalecer-desenvolvimento-regional-e-reduzir-desigualdades-no-pais) - Ministério da Integração e do Desenvolvimento Regional - 2024-03-26 - Lula signed a regional-development policy meant to reduce intraregional and interregional disparities, which is direct evidence of a broad-based prosperity strategy rather than narrow rent capture. Question IDs: 5B.1.

- [2024, o ano do combate à fome e redução da pobreza](https://www.gov.br/mds/pt-br/noticias-e-conteudos/desenvolvimento-social/noticias-desenvolvimento-social/2024-o-ano-do-combate-a-fome-e-reducao-da-pobreza) - Ministério do Desenvolvimento Social - 2024-12-23 - The government said 24.4 million people left severe food insecurity and poverty fell to its lowest level since 2012, which supports a claim of broad-based welfare gains rather than short-term elite extraction. Question IDs: 5B.1.

- [Taxa de desmatamento na Amazônia cai 30,6% e 25,7% no Cerrado](https://www.gov.br/mma/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/taxa-de-desmatamento-na-amazonia-cai-30-6-e-25-7-no-cerrado) - Brazil Ministry of Environment and Climate Change / INPE - 2024-11-06 - Official 2024 deforestation estimates fell sharply versus 2023, which strengthens the case that Lula was pursuing long-run productive sustainability rather than immediate distributive spoils. Question IDs: 5B.1.

- [Governo federal lança plano com 79 ações para promover a igualdade salarial e laboral entre mulheres e homens](https://www.gov.br/mulheres/pt-br/central-de-conteudos/noticias/2024/setembro/governo-federal-lanca-plano-com-79-acoes-para-promover-a-igualdade-salarial-e-laboral-entre-mulheres-e-homens) - Ministério das Mulheres - 2024-09-18 - The government launched a 79-action plan with budgeted interministerial measures to reduce workplace discrimination and expand women’s access and advancement, which supports broad-based prosperity rather than loyalty buying. Question IDs: 5B.1, 4B.7.

- [Governo federal destina mais de 120 mil hectares a 4,5 mil quilombolas](https://www.gov.br/igualdaderacial/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/governo-federal-destina-mais-de-120-mil-hectares-a-4-5-mil-quilombolas) - Ministério da Igualdade Racial - 2024-09-19 - Lula delivered land titles to quilombola communities, resolving a long-standing territorial claim and broadening participation in productive assets. Question IDs: 5B.1, 4B.7.

- [Lula anuncia criação de Autoridade Climática](https://www.gov.br/mma/pt-br/lula-anuncia-criacao-de-autoridade-climatica) - Brazil Ministry of Environment and Climate Change - 2024-09-10 - Lula announced a Climate Authority and technical-scientific committee to coordinate extreme-climate response, which is consistent with an investment-heavy, long-horizon prosperity approach. Question IDs: 5B.1, 4B.4.

- [Brazil improves fiscal outlook for the year, still needs freeze to stay within rule](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-government-improves-fiscal-outlook-for-the-year-3626553) - Reuters via Investing.com - 2024-09-20 - The government cut its deficit forecast but still needed a new spending freeze to comply with the fiscal rule, which is evidence of some willingness to accept short-term political cost for macro stability. Question IDs: 5B.1, 4B.4.

- [Approval of Brazil's Lula government slightly falls, ties with disapproval - poll](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/approval-of-brazils-lulas-government-slightly-falls-ties-with-disapproval--poll-3348780) - Reuters via Investing.com - 2024-03-21 - This is weak negative evidence only: Lula had mixed approval in March, which suggests he was not simply maximizing popularity, but it does not by itself prove a prosperity-oriented strategy. Question IDs: 5B.1.

- [Approval of Brazil's Lula goes up in July, Reuters poll finds](https://www.yahoo.com/news/approval-brazils-lula-goes-july-115612793.html) - Reuters via Yahoo News - 2024-07-10 - The article notes that 66% supported Lula’s criticism of the central bank and that markets worried about fiscal targets and the real; this is the clearest caveat for short-term popularity pressures, though it is still indirect rather than proof of rent-seeking. Question IDs: 5B.1, 4B.4.

Search gap: I did not find direct 2024 evidence that Lula used patronage, rent extraction, or loyalty buying as a core governing method. The negative side is mostly indirect: populist pressure on the central bank, fiscal stress, and political popularity management rather than explicit rent-seeking.
